label: Deactivate triggers
description: Turn off triggers: the program's own, or with `instance` that instance's per-instance triggers. `door` says what happens to work arriving while they are down, `held` to the work they already hold, `running` to the runs going now; ActivateTriggers brings them back.

inputs.name: instance
inputs.description: Whose triggers: an instance id your program gives it (`user-42`), for that instance's per-instance triggers. Unwired: the program's own triggers, the ones shared by every instance. Wired, and no id arrives (the node feeding it did not run): this node skips.

inputs.name: only
inputs.description: Only these triggers, named as the program writes them. Unwired: all of them (every shared trigger, or every per-instance trigger of the instance).

inputs.name: door
inputs.label: Door
inputs.description: What happens to work arriving at the triggers while they are down: take holds it for when they are back (a question stays listed for the people who answer it), hide holds it out of their sight, refuse takes nothing.

inputs.name: doorForMinutes
inputs.label: Door for minutes
inputs.description: With take or hide: the door refuses once this many minutes have passed. Unset: it holds until the triggers are back.

inputs.name: held
inputs.label: Held work
inputs.description: The work already held on them (events held while they were down, runs they fired that are paused on a wait): keep it for when they are back, or drop it, cancelling the paused runs.

inputs.name: running
inputs.label: Running work
inputs.description: The runs the triggers fired that are going right now: wait lets them finish on the version they started on, cancel stops them.

inputs.name: includeSelf
inputs.label: Stop this run too
inputs.description: On: this run is cancelled too when it is one of the runs reached.

outputs.name: done
outputs.description: True once the triggers are down; under `running: wait` the runs they fired may still be finishing on their own version.

then.message: DeactivateTriggers '{id}' names {names} in `only`, which is no per-instance trigger of this program. It is given an `instance`, so it acts on that instance's triggers: name each the way the program writes it (`inbox`, `work.inbox` inside a group, or `one.inbox` inside an included file), or leave `instance` unwired to act on the program's own triggers.

DeactivateTriggers '{id}' names {names} in `only`, which is no shared trigger of this program. It has no `instance`, so it acts on the program's own triggers: name each the way the program writes it (`inbox`, `work.inbox` inside a group, or `one.inbox` inside an included file), or wire `instance` to act on an instance's per-instance triggers.
DeactivateTriggers '{id}' refuses what arrives and sets `doorForMinutes`, which only counts down a door that takes or hides work. Pick take or hide for `door`, or leave `doorForMinutes` unset.
